title: No way to clear the screen.

author: Randomnickblahblah
title: Too reliant on watching ads
content:
This ought to be a great game but they turned the difficulty dial up to the point when you will need to watch two ads, on average, per game. Given the unreliability of ads actually finishing, you cannot complete many of the levels even if you enjoy modern ads. Which you do not. This game uses unity ads which lets you report broken ads and forfeit the benefit, except that feature doesn’t work. You’re just stuck with o option but to shut the game down.
The game also doesn’t look right on iPad. You can’t see the tops of the images.

author: Johny Quickly
title: Unplayable without watching Ads
content:
Update: Watching the Ad when one needs to add a spot does NOT add a spot. This has happened 3 times. This is just a fraud that Apple needs to look into. When you say that a consumable will come after an Ad, it should come to the player. 

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
I get it that ads are a necessity. But this game isn’t playable without forcibly watching ads 2-3 times within a single round. There’s no logical way to move the vehicles given the patterns without watching an Ad to get an extra space. It’s sad that such games are allowed by Apple now.
